title: Magic Island, Ala Moana Park & Kaka'ako Waterfront Park Glide
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Honolulu’s in-town beach glide on a fun 2.5-hour Segway adventure! After a quick training, cruise to Magic Island for Waikiki and Diamond Head views, then explore Ala Moana Regional Beach Park’s open pathways loved by locals. Glide over a scenic bridge, pass Kewalo Basin’s lively harbor, and continue to Kakaʻako Waterfront Park—known as Point Panic for its iconic surf break and stunning oceanfront promenade. At the park’s summit, visit the Ehime Maru Memorial and Echo Stone while enjoying sweeping cross-island views. In winter, look for migrating whales offshore. This tour blends adventure, local favorite spots, and unforgettable island scenery into one unique Hawaiian experience.
